image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a black audio cassette tape resting on a wooden surface. The image focuses on the top-left quadrant of the cassette, showing the transparent plastic casing, two circular spool hubs, and a yellow label with illegible text. The bottom edge reveals the rectangular opening for the tape mechanism.
